title: Inter press scorecard: the papers went 2 for 14 this week
caption:
Inter in the Italian press this week: 14 claims, 2 came true.

Gazzetta dello Sport had Carlos Augusto starting at Bologna — he came off the bench and scored instead. Gazzetta's five-to-six weeks for Lautaro Martinez held up: Chivu said he's back after the November break. And Gazzetta still puts Milan in front for Tresoldi, with Inter saying nothing.
